title: IOE Model Paper 1 (100 questions, 140 marks)
html:
Instructions. Computer-based paper pattern of the IOE B.E./B.Arch. entrance (2083 booklet): 100 questions, 140 marks, 2 hours (120 minutes). Section A has 60 questions of 1 mark; Section B has 40 questions of 2 marks.

Each question has four options and one correct answer. A wrong answer costs 10 % of that question's marks: -0.1 in Section A, -0.2 in Section B. Leave a question unanswered to lose nothing.

The paper is numbered straight through and is arranged by subject within each section, as in the official model questions. Constants: g=10 m s⁻² unless stated, h=6.63\times10^{-34} J s, e=1.6\times10^{-19} C, N_A=6.02\times10^{23}.

Score yourself: score =(\text{right}\times1+\text{right}_B\times2)-0.1\times\text{wrong}_A-0.2\times\text{wrong}_B. Count from the answer key at the end.

Subject Section A (1 mark) Section B (2 marks) Questions Marks
Mathematics 1–20 61–75 35 50
Physics 21–34 76–88 27 40
Chemistry 35–48 89–96 22 30
English 49–60 97–100 16 20

The split of questions between subjects within the two sections is not published by IOE; this paper uses the 20+15 / 14+13 / 14+8 / 12+4 distribution that fits 60 + 40 questions and the subject marks 50 / 40 / 30 / 20.

Pacing. 120 minutes for 100 questions is 72 seconds each on average. A sound plan: Section A (60 questions) in 45 minutes, Section B (40) in 60 minutes, 15 minutes for returning to skipped questions.
